name: Palak paneer

steps.text: Blanch spinach 2 minutes, drain and blend smooth.
steps.cue: The spinach is bright green and fully wilted. Cool it in cold water so it keeps its colour.

steps.text: Heat ghee, fry cumin, onion, ginger and garlic until golden.
steps.cue: The onion is golden at the edges and the cumin is fragrant.

steps.text: Add tomato and curry powder, cook until soft.
steps.cue: The tomato has cooked down with no watery liquid left.

steps.text: Stir in spinach puree and cream, add paneer cubes, simmer 5 minutes.
steps.cue: The gravy is smooth and bright green and the paneer is soft.
steps.tip: Keep it at a gentle simmer once the cream goes in. A hard boil dulls the colour and can split the cream.

storage: Cool quickly and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Reheat gently in a pan with a splash of water. A hard boil dulls the colour and toughens the paneer.
